name: ai-swift
description: AI-powered Swift / iOS / macOS release-readiness and quality toolkit - catches Xcode Cloud and TestFlight blockers before upload (XcodeGen pbxproj drift, static build numbers, missing ci_scripts, macOS App Store entitlements/Info.plist, headless-CI keychain test failures, ad-hoc signing entitlement rejections, flaky-UITest release gating), diagnoses ITMS rejection emails and red CI logs, scaffolds Xcode Cloud CI, runs a portable local verify gate, and reviews Swift 6 strict-concurrency + SwiftUI code
